text:
"Over a restless evening, the desk crew recorded something about gate calls, and we are truly sorry" for the disruption you experienced when your animal travel plans were handled poorly and your onward journey was affected.

We review these events as a safety matter because delays, missed handoffs, and unclear updates can create avoidable stress for travelers and animals alike. Your complaint indicates that the service did not give you timely guidance, and that the connection plan and crate handling were not managed to the standard expected at Aurelia Skyways.

Please keep all boarding papers, baggage tags, and any written notices together, because these records support a careful review. <<FACT F118>> If you have a missed connection related to the same event, include the flight details, the booking reference, and a short description of the animal transfer issue so the claim can be matched to the record. <<FACT F110>> The Companion Animal Travel Desk will assess the case, confirm whether the issue was preventable, and route any eligible remedy through the correct channel.

For future travel, we recommend arriving with enough margin for check-in, carrier inspection, and any animal welfare review, and we advise staying near the gate area after check-in until the boarding call is confirmed. If a delay starts to build, notify the welcome team at once so they can protect the animal transfer sequence and reduce the chance of a missed handoff. Clear, respectful contact helps us act quickly and lowers risk for both the traveler and the pet.

We regret the distress this caused and we are treating the matter as a service failure that requires corrective attention. A review of the staff briefing, gate communication, and crate movement will be completed so that similar problems are less likely to recur. Please accept our apology for the inconvenience and the worry caused to you and your companion.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
